title: Large-scale Adoption of Digital Ordering and Cashless Payment Systems
what_it_is: Large-scale Adoption of Digital Ordering and Cashless Payment Systems

sections.label: Food services digital adoption factors
sections.summary: The Food Services ITM aims to cut manpower reliance; about 1,400 food outlets adopted digital services, with habit, cost and non-interoperable payment systems as key factors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: One of the focus areas of the Food Services Industry Transformation Map (ITM) launched last September is to reduce the industry's reliance on manpower.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: As of March 2017, approximately 1,400 food outlets, or 20% of all establishments, have adopted some form of digital services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: The key factors affecting the take-up of digital solutions are, first, habit; second, the cost of adoption; and third, the fact that many digital payment systems are currently not interoperable.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: First, for greater convenience of use, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), along with other agencies, is working with payment service providers to make essential payment modes available in a single device.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Second, both the National Environment Agency (NEA) and the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING) provide grants to offset the costs to stallholders of adopting digital service solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: NEA is also progressively rolling out cashless payments infrastructure at hawker centres.

sections.label: Coffee shop and adoption targets
sections.summary: The target is 100 more productive coffee shops by 2020 and 50% digital services adoption across food and beverage outlets by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: More productive coffee shops will be launched, and we have set a target to have 100 of these by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Through all of these initiatives, our goal is to achieve 50% adoption rate of digital services across all food and beverage outlets by 2020.
